title: My Dog Max
text:
Tom has a dog. His name is Max. Max is brown and very friendly. Every morning, Tom gives Max food and fresh water.

Tom walks Max in the park every day. Max likes to run and play with the ball. After the walk, Max sleeps on his bed. Tom loves his dog very much.

questions.text: What is the name of Tom's dog?
Where does Tom walk Max every day?
Why is Max probably happy after the walk?
options: He can rest on his bed
He has to go to school
He has to clean the house
He must find a new home

questions.text: What kind of person is Tom?
options: A caring person who looks after his dog
A person who does not like animals
A teacher who works at a school
A person who is always busy with work

vocabulary.definition: kind and pleasant to other people or animals
clean and new, not old or dirty
a large public area with grass and trees where people walk and play
a round object that you throw, kick or catch in games

paragraph_translations: Tom tem um cachorro. O nome dele é Max. Max é marrom e muito simpático. Todas as manhãs, Tom dá comida e água fresca para Max.
Tom leva Max para passear no parque todos os dias. Max gosta de correr e brincar com a bola. Depois do passeio, Max dorme na sua cama. Tom ama muito o seu cachorro.
